card.name: Digits and word starts in dosing text
card.fires_on: Fires on the first digit of numbers like 12 or 2.7 in dosing schedules and section references, and on the "avenous" part of intravenous. It appears in antifungal (voriconazole) label text.

modes.label: Digit in interval or reference
modes.description: The first digit of "12" after "every", or a digit inside a section cross-reference.

modes.label: Inside intravenous
modes.example: loading dose regimen of intr<<avenous>> voriconazole on Day 1 followed

card.writes: The promoted tokens are unrelated, and the suppressed ones are words starting with "ch", so the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It marks the middle of numbers like "every 12 hours" and the word intravenous in antifungal dosing tables.
evidence: Therapy must be initiated with the specified loading dose regimen of intr<<avenous>> voriconazole on Day 1 followed
